movers.quantum: Rs 608.67 cr of ANNUAL transmission charges for 35 years; the ~Rs 5,300 cr project cost is what it must spend
movers.headline: takes the **Letter of Intent from REC Power Development and Consultancy** for the Lakadia–Jam Khambhaliya–Jamnagar Part-B transmission system in Gujarat
says subsidiary Saatvik Solar Industries **accepted solar-module orders aggregating Rs 297.50 crore** from two undisclosed IPP and EPC buyers

movers.quantum: ~Rs 100.00 cr of ESTIMATED ANNUAL incremental revenue; ~26.0% of mcap
movers.headline: secures a **Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles award for SUV components at Sanand**, which it sizes as annual revenue potential rather than a booked order

movers.quantum: Rs 74.77 cr, the confirmed leg only; a further ~Rs 174.30 cr is an unsigned LoI
movers.headline: receives **work orders worth Rs 74.77 crore** from undisclosed domestic buyers for solar PV modules, for execution by December 2026
wins an **NHAI work order of Rs 48,25,29,635** as user fee agency at the Mangapatnam plaza on NH-67, Andhra Pradesh, for one year

movers.quantum: Rs 24.63 cr over three years; ~4.8% of mcap
movers.headline: takes a **Letter of Intent from TP Central Odisha Distribution worth Rs 24.63 crore including GST** for HT and LT network maintenance from 1 October
secures an **order of Rs 20.50 crore from Sri Balaji Bio Energies and Organics** for a 12 TPD compressed biogas plant, over nine months

order_wins: **Power Grid Corporation of India** — declared **successful bidder under TBCB for the Lakadia REZ Phase II (7,500 MW) inter-state system at quoted annual transmission charges of Rs 1,152.49 crore**, on BOOT basis, the LoI received 3 September; it adds a 765/400 kV Lakadia-II substation, 765 kV lines and a synchronous condenser _(~0.4% of mcap)_.

**Ceigall India** — receives the **LoI from REC Power Development and Consultancy** for the Part-B system evacuating Lakadia, Jam Khambhaliya and Jamnagar — a 765/400 kV AIS substation with 300 km of line — at **Rs 608.67 cr of annual transmission charges for 35 years**, against a project value of ~Rs 5,300 cr including GST.

**Saatvik Green Energy** — subsidiary Saatvik Solar Industries has **received and accepted orders aggregating Rs 297.50 cr** for solar PV modules from two undisclosed independent power producers and EPC players, for execution by March 2027 _(~5.6% of mcap)_.

**Autoline Industries** — a **business award from Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles** for critical ICE and EV SUV components at Sanand, which the release sizes at **approximately Rs 100 cr of estimated annual incremental revenue**, subject to ramp-up and customer schedules _(~26.0% of mcap)_.

**Solex Energy** — **work orders worth Rs 74.77 cr** from unnamed domestic entities for solar PV modules, for execution by December 2026; a further ~Rs 174.30 cr sits in an LoI whose Module Supply Agreement is still at signing stage, and ~Rs 846 cr is an order pipeline _(~9.7% of mcap on the confirmed leg)_.

**Innovision** — an **NHAI work order of Rs 48,25,29,635**, awarded 2 September, engaging it as user fee agency at the Mangapatnam Fee Plaza between Tadipatri and Jammalamadugu on NH-67 in Andhra Pradesh, with toilet-block upkeep, for one year _(~8.1% of mcap)_.

**Sugs Lloyd** — a **Letter of Intent from TP Central Odisha Distribution for maintenance of its HT & LT network, Rs 24,63,21,978 including GST** over three years from 1 October 2026, which the filing splits evenly at Rs 8,21,07,326 a year _(~4.8% of mcap)_.

**Ecoboard Industries** — an **order of Rs 20.50 cr from Sri Balaji Bio Energies and Organics** to design, procure, supply, erect and commission a 12 TPD compressed biogas plant, to be executed in nine months _(~11.8% of mcap)_.

**Monarch Surveyors and Engineering Consultants** — a **Rs 4.30 cr Letter of Acceptance from Maharashtra Airport Development Company** to consult on forest diversion, revenue coordination and statutory clearances for the proposed Gadchiroli greenfield airport _(~1.1% of mcap)_.
**Veerhealth Care** — a **monthly repeat order worth Rs 4.36 crore** for skin-care products from an unnamed leading Indian FMCG company, part of a 125-year-old group, to be executed within 45 days.

**Kothari Industrial Corporation** — a **Letter of Acceptance of Rs 4,15,31,817.60 over three years from Puliangudi Municipality, Tamil Nadu**, selecting it as food service provider for the Perunthalaivar Kamarajar Morning Breakfast Scheme.

**Hindustan Zinc** — the **Government of Karnataka issues a Letter of Intent naming it preferred bidder for a mining lease over the 314.21-hectare Gundlupet rare-earth and yttrium block** in Chamrajnagar district. No consideration is stated.

**Happy Square Outsourcing (White Force)** — a **third extension of its MPPTCL Shivpuri work order, approximately Rs 1.27 cr inclusive of taxes**, over six months from 1 October 2026; the order was first awarded in 2023 and extended twice in 2025.

**Zodiac Energy** — wins **three awards at the Global Solar Expo 2026 in Ahmedabad**, for solar developer of the year on KUSUM/DREEP projects, best-performing KUSUM projects in Gujarat and business-model innovation. No order, no value.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Archit Organosys** — proposes issuing **up to 3,72,48,344 shares at Rs 65 for consideration other than cash**, swapping them with 44 named, promoter-heavy allottees for 1,86,24,172 shares — **92.20%** — of Archit Life Science valued at Rs 130 each. The filing states no aggregate; subject to the ensuing AGM.

**SMT Engineering** — approves issuing **up to 1,42,858 share warrants convertible within 18 months**, which its own outcome sizes at Rs 4,00,00,240, subject to shareholders and the exchange; the same meeting raises authorised capital to Rs 19.10 cr from Rs 18.10 cr, which is not capital raised.
equity_allotments: **Lippi Systems** — **allots 65,00,000 convertible warrants at Rs 56.84, Rs 36,94,60,000**, to five named members of the promoter family, on Rs 9,23,65,000 received as the 25% upfront; the Rs 27,70,95,000 balance falls due at Rs 42.63 each, with fresh member approval still sought under ICDR Reg 170(2).

**Shalimar Paints** — a **corrigendum that SHRINKS its preferential issue**: the cash leg falls to 83,03,072 shares (Rs 70,57,61,120) after NSE found **Pro Fin Capital Services ineligible under ICDR Reg 159(1)**, so 41,51,536 shares will not be allotted to it. EGM 11 September.

**Magson Retail and Distribution** — allots **5,26,800 shares on conversion of PAST warrants issued in April 2025**, collecting the Rs 3,68,43,075 balance of 75% at Rs 93.25 a share from two named non-promoters; 33,46,166 warrants remain outstanding.

**Stellant Securities (India)** — receives **BSE in-principle approval to list 1,50,000 shares of Rs 10 already allotted to a promoter on conversion of preferentially issued warrants**, by the exchange's letter of 2 September.

**Edelweiss Financial Services** — allots **9,450 equity shares of Re 1 under its Employees Stock Incentive Plan, 2011**, by its share allotment committee. An ESOP allotment is not fresh external capital.
m_and_a: **Welspun Investments and Commercials** — approves **infusing up to Rs 1,285 crore into wholly owned Vishwakarma Realty through 75 crore CCDs and 53.50 crore OCDs at Rs 10** _(~157.6% of mcap)_, which will then fund a promoter group company. The target was incorporated in December 2025 with Rs 5 lakh of capital, nil turnover and no business yet.

**One Global Service Provider** — issues **shares at Rs 553 aggregating Rs 39,54,17,120 to buy 51% each of Matrix Labs Diagnocare (Rs 35,97,81,800) and Matrix Labs (Rs 3,56,35,320)** from Suresh and Nithya S, the SPAs signed today. The money goes OUT: its own shares are the acquisition currency. Subject to members, AGM 29 September.

**Gujarat Apollo Industries** — approves **in principle the sale of 1,34,40,000 shares, 17.96%, of Credo Advanced Chemicals to Mr Naman Madhav Patel for Rs 37,63,20,000**, under an SPA dated 3 September and completing within 90 days, subject to shareholders at the 28 September AGM. The annexure records a non-related-party buyer.

**Cohance Lifesciences** — its IBA committee approves **USD 13 million to lift NJ Bio from 56% to 67.3% and USD 5 million for about 65% of Aruka Bio**, a total the release itself puts at USD 18 million. Proposed, subject to definitive agreements; no rupee figure is stated and none is computed here.

**ACE Software Exports** — signs a **share purchase agreement for all 10,000 shares of QeApps Private Limited at Rs 12,000 a share**, which will make QeApps a wholly owned subsidiary. The filing states no aggregate — Rs 12.00 cr is our multiplication of its own two figures, and it is kept out of movers for that reason.

**GB Global** — the **NCLT Mumbai sanctions its amalgamation INTO unlisted Dev Land & Housing** by order of 12 August, certified copy received 1 September, in CP (CAA) No. 6/MB/2026 — so its own equity shares stand to be delisted. No swap ratio or value is stated in the intimation.

**Unihealth Hospitals** — **completes a share swap taking Victoria Hospital, Uganda from 50.00% to 99.81%** on 2,55,544 shares, for consideration other than cash, in continuation of its intimation of 3 July 2026. The filing states no value at all.

**Valencia Nutrition** — approves **hiving off its entire business by slump sale into five newly formed Valencia-named private companies**, subject to members. The cached pages state no consideration for any of the five.
**Mawana Sugars** — the **NCLT Delhi sanctions the amalgamation of Mawana Foods into it** by order of 3 September 2026. The intimation states neither a value nor a share-exchange ratio.

**Avalon Technologies** — executes a **joint-venture agreement with Zollner Elektronik AG of Germany**, forming Zollner Avalon Private Limited **51:49 in Zollner's favour** with a call option on a further 2% to take Avalon to 51%. Manufacturing is restricted to India; the only figure, Rs 2,00,000, is the new company's authorised capital.

**Rajputana Industries** — approves acquiring **14.21% of Shera Global Ventures LLP for Rs 1.46 cr of equity plus Rs 6.74 cr as security contribution** to source renewable power for **captive** consumption. The annexure records it as a related-party transaction: two directors are designated partners and the LLP shares the filer's own address.

**Pidilite Industries** — receives the **winding-up certificate for Nina Percept (Bangladesh)**, a wholly owned step-down subsidiary voluntarily liquidated with effect from 19 August. It was inoperative since incorporation, with nil turnover.

**Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers** — signs **memoranda of understanding with DNV and with Damen**, for which its own Reg-30 annexure records that **no financial implication has been ascertained at present**.

**ZF Steering Gear (India)** — reports progress on the **purchase of a land plot by a wholly owned subsidiary**, in continuation of its intimation of 24 July 2026. No consideration is disclosed in the cached pages.

**Kaiser Corporation** — applies to BSE for **in-principle approval of its scheme of amalgamation of Emazing Deals into itself** — a procedural step on a scheme already disclosed, carrying no value and no ratio.
capex_core: **Sterlite Technologies** — its board approves **adding about 50% to installed optical-fibre-cable capacity at an investment of ~Rs 3,000 crore by end-FY29**, funded from internal accruals and/or debt. Existing utilisation is ~70%; the existing capacity itself is withheld as commercially sensitive.

**UltraTech Cement** — the Aditya Birla Group launches **Ultravolt, a wires and cables business housed under UltraTech, backed by an investment of Rs 1,800 crore**, which it says makes it the second largest player in wires by capacity at launch.

**Max Healthcare Institute** — infuses **~Rs 87.87 crore into Kalinga Hospital, an existing subsidiary, by subscribing to its rights issue** within 15 days. The Rs 155.64 cr and Rs 21.54 cr beside it in the annexure are Kalinga's FY2025-26 revenue and paid-up capital, not the consideration.

**Balu Forge Industries** — acquires a **ring rolling production line able to roll 6.7 m outer diameter and 18,000 kg per product, adding 18,000 tons of capacity**, with trials before end-2026. The release states no price.
**Sumeet Industries** — **fully commissions new FDY lines of 40 tons a day** from 1 September after trial runs, lifting FDY capacity to 160 tons a day from 120. No project cost is stated.
business_updates: **Results season** — 8 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Prestige Estates Projects** — adds a **17.14-acre parcel in Sector 109, Gurgaon** with about 2.8 million sq ft of saleable area and an **estimated gross development value of ~Rs 5,600 crore** — a pipeline figure over the project's life, not a booked sale.

**XTGlobal Infotech** — is **selected as a qualified technology partner under a US state government cloud, AI/ML and generative-AI programme**, initially two years with three one-year renewals. Its USD 50–100 million is the addressable opportunity across the whole qualified vendor pool, not a contract value.

**EMS Limited** — emerges **lowest bidder (L-1) for a ~Rs 218.65 crore sewerage project including GST** from Rajasthan's Directorate of Local Bodies, across six urban local bodies, over 18 months with 10 years of O&M. An L-1 status is not an award, so it stays out of movers.
**Lalithaa Jewellery Mart** — opens its **65th showroom, 6,918 sq ft on G.N.T. Road at Redhills, Chennai**. The release states no investment or revenue figure.
distress_risk: **RBL Bank** — receives a **GST show-cause notice of Rs 164,13,53,222 under section 73 for FY2022-23** from the Assistant Commissioner, Delhi, over an input-tax-credit mismatch in its bullion vertical. The demand is proposed and includes interest and penalty; the bank expects no material adverse impact.

**Consolidated Finvest & Holdings** — receives the **initial public announcement of a voluntary DELISTING offer under Regulation 8** from promoter-group acquirer Concatenate Advest Advisory, with Jindal India Powertech acting in concert, **for 81,17,327 shares — 25.11% — held by the public**. No offer price appears in the cached pages.

**3i Infotech** — **settles five assessment years of income-tax litigation under the Vivad Se Vishwas scheme**. Its Rs 798.38 crore is the disputed additions and disallowances, not a payment: the filing says the amount payable was adjusted against brought-forward losses with **no incremental cashflow**.
**BIL Vyapar** — its **committee of creditors approves the resolution plan of Fairplan Distributors** at the 17th CoC meeting. No plan value is stated in the intimation.

**Marg Techno Projects** — approves **voluntary delisting from the Metropolitan Stock Exchange alone, without an exit opportunity**, under Regulations 5 and 6; its shares remain listed on BSE, so public shareholders keep a market.

**TeamLease Services** — its **appeal before the Gujarat High Court over the NEEM matter, filed by TeamLease Skills University, is adjourned to 22 September**. No amount is restated in the intimation.
**Jagran Prakashan** — the **section 241/242 oppression petition between the Gupta family, C.P. No. 64 of 2023, is adjourned to 7 October**. The company reports no order against it.
**Fractal Analytics** — places its **Swedish step-down subsidiary into voluntary solvent liquidation**. The intimation states no write-off or financial impact.
**Shree Hanuman Sugar & Industries** — gives notice of its **19th committee-of-creditors meeting on 4 September**. A meeting notice carries no decision and no value.
**CLC Industries** — files a **promoter reclassification request** under a letter dated 22 June. No shareholding change takes effect on this filing.
open_offers: **Ahimsa Industries Limited** — acquirer not parsed open offer (14.23 lakh shares) at Rs 25 vs CMP 25.75 (-2.9%); **DO NOT TENDER - market pays more than the offer**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 14 cr
other_notable: **The Great Eastern Shipping** — confirms **4 September as the opening date of the Rs 900 cr open-market buyback at up to Rs 1,530 a share**, which the 2 September digest already carried; the board approved it on 27 August. The date is the only new fact.

**Man Infraconstruction** — submits the **public announcement dated 2 September for its open-market buyback of Rs 2 shares**, following the board approval of 1 September already disclosed. The cached pages state neither size nor price.
**Advanced Enzyme Technologies** — buys back **31,571 shares on 3 September at an average Rs 295.39**, taking its open-market programme to 9,73,456 shares.
**SIS** — buys back **20,000 shares on 3 September at an average Rs 436.11**, taking its open-market programme to 8,21,000 shares.

**Balkrishna Industries** — its finance committee approves an **issue of non-convertible debentures of Rs 550 crore on private placement**, further to its intimation of 18 August. Debt, so it is not a fund raise.

**CreditAccess Grameen** — raises **Rs 300 crore of non-convertible debentures placed bilaterally with Barclays Bank PLC**, fully subscribed. Debt, and barred from the raise themes for the same reason.
**Brookfield India Real Estate Trust** — reports an **institutional investor meeting held on 2 September** on its business and financial update for the June quarter.
**Embassy Office Parks REIT** — discloses a **trading plan under the insider-trading regulations by the spouse of a director**. It is a personal dealing disclosure, not a trust transaction.

**Titan Biotech Ltd** — Recommended Issuance of Bonus Shares, subject to shareholders approval and any other applicable regulatory and statutory approval, in ratio of 1:4 i.e. 1(one) new fully paid up Equity Shares ....
**Integrated Proteins Ltd** — The company has informed the exchange regarding New ISIN INE177M01021 with respect to sub -division/Split of equity shares of the company.
**Kairosoft AI Solutions Ltd** — Record date identified for sub division of shares
